scheme_name: PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description:
The PM-YASASVI scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India aimed at providing financial assistance to students from Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Denotified Tribes (DNT) who are pursuing post-matriculation education.

The scheme was officially launched on September 1, 2021, under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. 

The primary objective of the PM-YASASVI scheme is to enhance the educational opportunities for students belonging to marginalized communities. 

The scheme aims to provide financial support to students so that they can pursue higher education without the burden of financial constraints.

The government has set a target to provide scholarships to approximately 2 lakh students annually under this scheme.

The scholarship covers various courses including undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma courses across different fields of study.

The financial assistance provided under the PM-YASASVI scheme is substantial. 

Eligible students can receive a scholarship amount of up to INR 75,000 per annum.

The scholarship is intended to cover tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other related educational expenses.

The eligibility criteria for the PM-YASASVI scheme are specific and detailed. 

Students must belong to the OBC, EBC, or DNT categories as recognized by the Government of India.

The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.

Students must have completed their matriculation (10th grade) and must be enrolled in a post-matriculation course.

There is no age limit specified for applicants under this scheme.

The application process for the PM-YASASVI scheme is straightforward but requires specific documentation. 

Interested candidates must apply online through the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

The application form must be filled out with accurate personal and educational details.

Applicants are required to upload necessary documents including caste certificates, income certificates, and proof of admission to a post-matriculation course.

The application window for the PM-YASASVI scheme typically opens in the month of August each year.

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for the end of September.

Once the applications are submitted, they are reviewed by the respective authorities.

Eligible candidates are then selected based on merit and financial need.

The disbursement of the scholarship amount is done directly into the bank accounts of the selected students.

This ensures transparency and efficiency in the distribution of funds.

The scholarship amount is disbursed in two installments during the academic year.

The first installment is generally released at the beginning of the academic session.

The second installment is released after the completion of the first semester.

The implementing authority for the PM-YASASVI scheme is the Ministry of Education, Government of India.

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is responsible for conducting the entrance test for the selection of candidates.

The contact details for the Ministry of Education can be found on their official website.

The PM-YASASVI scheme also emphasizes the importance of education for social upliftment and empowerment.

By providing financial support, the government aims to reduce dropout rates among students from marginalized communities.

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of the nation by fostering a more educated workforce.

Statistically, the scheme aims to improve the enrollment rates of OBC, EBC, and DNT students in higher education institutions.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 200 crore for the implementation of the PM-YASASVI scheme for the financial year 2021-2022.

This budget is expected to cover the scholarship amounts for the targeted 2 lakh students.

The PM-YASASVI scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to promote inclusive education.

Other similar schemes include the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBCs and the Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students.

The PM-YASASVI scheme is designed to complement these existing initiatives and provide additional support to deserving students.

The scheme also aims to create awareness among students about the importance of education and skill development.

Through this initiative, the government hopes to empower students to achieve their academic and professional goals.

The success of the PM-YASASVI scheme will be measured by the number of students who benefit from the scholarship and continue their education.

Regular assessments and feedback mechanisms are expected to be put in place to evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

The PM-YASASVI scheme represents a significant step towards achieving educational equity in India.

By focusing on the needs of OBC, EBC, and DNT students, the government is addressing historical injustices and promoting social justice.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to ensuring that every student has the opportunity to succeed academically.

In conclusion, the PM-YASASVI scheme is a comprehensive welfare initiative aimed at supporting students from marginalized communities in their pursuit of higher education. 

With its specific eligibility criteria, substantial financial assistance, and streamlined application process, the scheme is poised to make a meaningful impact on the educational landscape of India. 

The government’s investment in this scheme reflects its recognition of education as a fundamental right and a powerful tool for social change.
